    Basic data of the opposite algebra #

    Basic data for Cᵐᵒᵖ give basic data for C (unopB), with corners, arrows and the chain condition corresponding under op (mem_Mk_unopB, arr_unopB, chainX_unopB). Left chains in C are right chains in Cᵐᵒᵖ (rchain_of_lchain).

    BasicData k C

    The basic data of C obtained from those of Cᵐᵒᵖ.
